description: MicroBin: a small pastebin and file-sharing server with private, read-only and encrypted uploads, expiry and an admin page, with the admin password generated at install and the data on a volume. Hardened by QuenchWorks: built from source, nonroot, CVE-gated, cosign-signed and pinned by digest.

miniserve: a small file server with directory listing, uploads, archive downloads, basic auth with a generated password and native TLS, serving a volume. Hardened by QuenchWorks: built from source, nonroot, CVE-gated, cosign-signed and pinned by digest.
